question: What business outcomes are you trying to achieve with BI?

How important are polished, presentation-quality dashboards and data storytelling?
Is AI-assisted or natural-language analytics a priority?
How much does licensing cost drive the decision?
How many people will use the dashboards?
Do you have strict governance or compliance requirements?
What are your security needs — RLS, SSO, data residency?
Is a vendor-hosted (SaaS) BI platform acceptable?
Do you have a defined data model or semantic layer in your existing reporting today?
How mature is the current reporting governance process?
Are there any AI governance concerns to be aware about?
Who will be building these reports.
What’s the team’s technical skill level (SQL, DAX)?
How much training/change management can you support, if needed?
